submission.justification: Crystal-K1 has the best raw resolution (2.9% in the 2025 summary), but the Q1 2026 radiopurity assay measured its intrinsic background at 2.0 +- 0.2 counts/kg/day, four times the facility budget of 0.5, driven by internal contamination. That makes it unsuitable for a low-background screening spectrometer. Crystal-K2 is the cleanest (0.10) but its resolution is 8.4-12% across 2-10 cm. Crystal-K3 is within budget (0.30 +- 0.05 counts/kg/day) and gives the best resolution of the compliant candidates. Simulated FWHM at 662 keV for K3: 2 cm 5.50%, 4 cm 4.71%, 5 cm 4.52%, 6 cm 4.51%, 7 cm 4.79%, 10 cm 6.34%. The minimum lies around 5-6 cm, and 6 cm gave the lowest simulated value. The DAQ needs no change for K3.

requirements.requirement: Crystal must be one of the three candidates in candidate_specs.md
Suitable for low-background operation (intrinsic background within 0.5 counts/kg/day budget)
requirements.evidence: Q1 2026 assay: K3 intrinsic background 0.30 +- 0.05 counts/kg/day. K1 (2.0) fails the budget; K2 (0.10) passes but has worse resolution.

requirements.requirement: Best possible energy resolution at 662 keV among compliant options
requirements.evidence: Simulated K3 FWHM 4.51% at 6 cm, vs K2 best 8.44% at 5 cm. K1 (2.9%) is excluded by background. Scan of K3: 2, 4, 5, 6, 7, 10 cm gave 5.50, 4.71, 4.52, 4.51, 4.79, 6.34%.
